releases.body:
Subagent cost reporting improvements.

- **Subagents** section now shows token usage as `in/out/c` (reasoning folded into `out`):
  - collapsed: cumulative usage + cost across all subagents
  - expanded: one block per subagent (`subagent_type: description`) with its own `in/out/c` and cost
- New **Total** line: active-session models + all subagents, i.e. the real session spend.
- README updated (preview, features, usage).

Adds subagent token/cost tracking.

- New collapsible **Subagents** section in the cost panel.
- Collapsed: cumulative token/cost of all subagent (child) sessions.
- Expanded: one row per subagent (`subagent_type: description`) with its tokens and cost.
- Subagent sessions are discovered recursively from the parent session''s `task` tool parts, so nested subagents are included.
- README updated with the new section, KV key (`token-cost-tracker.subagents_expanded`), and limitations.

Documentation release.

- Rewrote the README: badges, features, install (npm + local), usage, KV keys, how it works, limitations, troubleshooting.
- No code changes; plugin behaviour is identical to v0.1.0.

Initial release.

- Bottom status line: session-wide cache/input/output/reason token totals and token-weighted average tokens/sec, centered over the chat pane.
- Right sidebar Cost panel: per-model totals, listed rates, per-category token counts and estimated cost; collapsible output/reason.
- DeepSeek peak/off-peak aware pricing: peak usage shown as a separate `<model> (peak)` entry at 2x rates (peak = 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Mon-Fri).
- Full-session token accounting via the SDK (not limited to the last 100 messages).

Install: add `opencode-token-cost-tracker` to your `~/.config/opencode/tui.json` plugin array.

MIT licensed.
